title: Covered Share of the Term on Catch-Up Upgrade Charges
content:
**Rule.** On a Rental Property Service Contracts catch-up charge for a tier upgrade, the covered share of the term — the share of the annual tier difference the charge bills — follows where the term in which the upgrade was made stands:

1. **The contract shows an end date for that term** (the contract record carries the date the contract ended): the share is the whole calendar months from the upgrade date to that term's end date, counted down to whole months, divided by 12.
2. **That term is still running and the upgrade was made with fewer than half (0.5) of the term's days remaining:** the share is those whole calendar months plus one, divided by 12.
3. **Otherwise:** the share is the calendar days from the day after the upgrade date through the term end, divided by the term's days counted from its first day through its last day inclusive.

The upgrade date is the plan change date on the contract; the term end is the term end date on the contract. The days remaining are counted from the day after the upgrade date through the term end; "fewer than half" compares them with 0.5 times the term's days.

## Decision table

| End date shown for the upgrade's term | Days remaining after the upgrade | Share |
|---|---|---|
| yes | any | whole months to the term end, divided by 12 |
| no | fewer than half of the term's days | whole months to the term end, plus one, divided by 12 |
| no | half of the term's days or more | days remaining divided by the term's days |

## Boundary of the half-term test (hypothetical 365-day running term)

Half of 365 days is 182.5 days. With 182 days remaining the upgrade was made with fewer than half remaining (row 2); with 183 days remaining it was not (row 3).

## Hypothetical shares

- Upgrade on 10 June, term ending 9 March, contract now showing an end date: whole months from 10 June to 9 March are 8 (10 June to 10 February is 8 months; the rest is short of a month). Share: 8 divided by 12.
- Same dates, term still running with 272 days remaining of 365: row 3, share 272 divided by 365.
- Running term, 140 days remaining of 365, 4 whole months to the term end: row 2, share 5 divided by 12.

The share multiplies the annual tier difference; the charge is rounded to the cent once at the end, never the share.
